newsitem.title: UK: BFI up four as Panamaxes remain firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI up four as Panamaxes remain firm.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up four points at 1,266 on Friday with the chief area of pressure in the freight market again early Panamaxes in the Atlantic.
Rates have improved marginally for the most part but occasional fixtures at considerably higher levels have been seen.

The Glencore relet Oinoussian Seaman 64,000 dwt was understood fixed on subjects by Seatrans delivery East Coast South America for a trip to the Far East at close to $12,250 daily plus $225,000 bonus.
Brokers also believed that Panamax rates in the rates in the Pacific are set to rise.
On the other hand Capers in the Atlantic are in weaker demand. GKE fixed Thalassini Avra for 110,000 coal HR to Rotterdam at a significanly weaker $5.60.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 15 to 20 points higher and turnover totalled 66 lots.
